instructionSummary:
1. Chnage the app and project name to VirtuX
2. This not a information posting platform. It is a virtual persona generation tool. Where individual virtual person live and act like real person. 
3. Initial Virtual user development life cycle will be dynamic by openAI.
       For example:
                  user going to give some information such as age, profession, hometown etc. create an openAI agent whose job is going to ask the user about the personality of the virtual person. Based on the information available OpenAI should generate a virtual person. This person will have day to day activites. it will have randomisations. But according to virtual persona he/she will act in every certain time. 
4. During its day to day life style this virtual user will keep posting in instagram. If whatsapp number is available then reply or messeage there with given contacts.
5. for Social media it should have a memory/knowledge which will help to build a style of the person - how to talk, how to behave etc. this pattern will reflect in the user activities as well. Just like real personality
